recentItems.title: ODU, Norfolk State fans excited for first football meetig since 2019
recentItems.description: Old Dominion and Norfolk State met on the football field for the first time since 2019 Saturday night and fans of both schools turned out to catch the action.

recentItems.title: Old Dominion tops Norfolk State in the Battle of Norfolk
recentItems.description: The Monarchs forced three turnovers and pulled away late to secure a 31-10 victory over their cross-town foes. Quinn Henicle posted four total touchdowns and the ODU defense held the Spartans to 220 total yards.

recentItems.title: ‘Wild’ and ‘exciting’: Music fans pack Norfolk Scope for 2026 Cousinz Festival
recentItems.description: Fans from across Virginia gathered at Norfolk Scope for the third annual Cousinz Festival, featuring T.I., Keyshia Cole and a night of music and celebration.

recentItems.title: First Warning Forecast: Storms fade, pleasant conditions arrive in time for Labor Day
recentItems.description: Scattered storms capable of producing severe weather are possible through this evening. Temperatures drop tomorrow with lower humidity and drier conditions expected.

recentItems.title: French and U.S. Navy officials honor 245th anniversary of the Battle of the Capes at Fort Story
recentItems.description: The ceremony at Fort Story honored three historically intertwined milestones: the 245th anniversary of the Battle of the Capes, the 400th anniversary of the French Navy, and the 50th anniversary of the Comte de Grasse statue.

recentItems.title: First Warning Forecast: Another round of storms today, Cooler and less humid this weekend
recentItems.description: Building clouds today with scattered storms this afternoon to evening. Highs in the mid to upper 80s today, dropping to the low 80s tomorrow. More sunshine for Labor Day.

recentItems.title: Friday Night Redzone: Weather wreaks havoc once again
recentItems.description: A handful of games kicked off, but called it quits early, while others resumed late into the night hours. Maury and Varina went down to the wire in our Game of the Week.

recentItems.title: Chesapeake family shares 22-month-old son's fight for survival against two rare heart defects
recentItems.description: Everton Johnson was born with two critical heart defects. His mother says faith and community carried her family through cardiac arrest, a stroke, and more.

recentItems.title: Veterans Bridge drivers see backlogged E-ZPass charges after equipment upgrade
recentItems.description:
Chesapeake neighbor Jennie Lewis drives the Dominion Boulevard Veterans Bridge almost every day. She said she did not know what was happening when she saw 16 E-ZPass charges hit her account all at once this week.

A spokesperson from the City of Chesapeake said tolling equipment on the Veterans Bridge was being upgraded beginning July 20 on the northbound side and July 27 on the southbound side. E-Z Pass drivers were not charged during that time. The backlogged charges are now rolling in.

Lewis said the unexpected late charges are putting a strain on her budget and that drivers should have been warned ahead of time.

recentItems.title: First Warning Forecast: Much cooler weather arrives Labor Day weekend
recentItems.description: Strong to severe storms are expected through 10 PM this evening, with storms and showers fading after midnight. Cooler temperatures arrive Saturday.
